problem_text:
A logistics firm is tasked with distributing nine distinct categories of relief supplies to a disaster-stricken region, each category requiring passage through nine separate checkpoint inspections before delivery. The operational subsidy allocated per ton for each supply category is detailed as follows:
* For Category Alpha, the subsidy is 18.227 per ton.
* For Category Beta, the subsidy is 14.364 per ton.
* For Category Gamma, the subsidy is 6.651 per ton.
* For Category Delta, the subsidy is 14.861 per ton.
* For Category Epsilon, the subsidy is 19.944 per ton.
* For Category Zeta, the subsidy is 10.479 per ton.
* For Category Eta, the subsidy is 16.558 per ton.
* For Category Theta, the subsidy is 14.857 per ton.
* For Category Iota, the subsidy is 12.126 per ton.

The mandatory inspection duration per ton for each checkpoint is provided:
*For Category Alpha, Checkpoint 1 consumes 0.928 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 consumes 0.585 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 consumes 0.952 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 consumes 0.68 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 consumes 1.075 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 6 consumes 1.405 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 7 consumes 1.796 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 8 consumes 0.462 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 9 consumes 1.658 (ton-hours).
*For Category Beta, Checkpoint 1 consumes 1.572 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 consumes 1.331 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 consumes 0.546 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 consumes 0.329 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 consumes 0.446 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 6 consumes 0.779 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 7 consumes 0.724 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 8 consumes 1.659 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 9 consumes 0.818 (ton-hours).
*For Category Gamma, Checkpoint 1 consumes 0.492 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 consumes 1.956 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 consumes 1.469 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 consumes 1.646 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 consumes 1.095 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 6 consumes 0.374 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 7 consumes 1.255 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 8 consumes 1.001 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 9 consumes 0.772 (ton-hours).
*For Category Delta, Checkpoint 1 consumes 0.357 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 consumes 0.769 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 consumes 0.69 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 consumes 0.841 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 consumes 1.484 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 6 consumes 0.41 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 7 consumes 0.882 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 8 consumes 1.566 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 9 consumes 0.757 (ton-hours).
*For Category Epsilon, Checkpoint 1 consumes 1.741 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 consumes 1.755 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 consumes 0.541 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 consumes 1.369 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 consumes 1.351 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 6 consumes 0.506 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 7 consumes 1.204 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 8 consumes 1.055 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 9 consumes 0.633 (ton-hours).
*For Category Zeta, Checkpoint 1 consumes 1.483 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 consumes 1.812 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 consumes 1.814 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 consumes 0.39 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 consumes 0.882 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 6 consumes 0.361 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 7 consumes 1.035 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 8 consumes 1.394 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 9 consumes 1.472 (ton-hours).
*For Category Eta, Checkpoint 1 consumes 0.304 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 consumes 0.403 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 consumes 1.338 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 consumes 1.703 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 consumes 1.294 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 6 consumes 0.369 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 7 consumes 0.347 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 8 consumes 1.245 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 9 consumes 0.59 (ton-hours).
*For Category Theta, Checkpoint 1 consumes 1.546 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 consumes 0.744 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 consumes 1.687 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 consumes 1.824 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 consumes 1.156 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 6 consumes 1.465 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 7 consumes 1.575 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 8 consumes 1.328 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 9 consumes 1.364 (ton-hours).
*For Category Iota, Checkpoint 1 consumes 0.927 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 consumes 1.807 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 consumes 0.519 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 consumes 0.491 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 consumes 1.504 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 6 consumes 0.581 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 7 consumes 1.136 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 8 consumes 1.823 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 9 consumes 0.844 (ton-hours).

* The cumulative inspection time at Checkpoint 1 is capped at 229.47 hours.
* The cumulative inspection time at Checkpoint 2 is capped at 295.193 hours.
* The cumulative inspection time at Checkpoint 3 is capped at 166.113 hours.
* The cumulative inspection time at Checkpoint 4 is capped at 191.501 hours.
* The cumulative inspection time at Checkpoint 5 is capped at 213.591 hours.
* The cumulative inspection time at Checkpoint 6 is capped at 112.31 hours.
* The cumulative inspection time at Checkpoint 7 is capped at 241.347 hours.
* The cumulative inspection time at Checkpoint 8 is capped at 209.657 hours.
* The cumulative inspection time at Checkpoint 9 is capped at 180.444 hours.

Under the imperative condition that for every checkpoint from 1 through 9, the aggregate processing duration must remain within its stipulated availability, determine the optimal tonnage allocation for each supply category to maximize the total operational subsidy.
